title: Top of the Tower
description: At the top of the city's tallest tower, a dark penthouse looks out through a wall of glass over a city of towers and a river where small boats drift past. Rain runs down the glass and lightning flickers behind the clouds as the wind buffets the tower. Inside, one floor lamp throws a gentle warm glow beside an empty leather armchair and a glass of whisky: a quiet, lonely seat at the top of the world.

title: Attic Study, Snowy Night
description: A small attic study late at night, tucked under chunky wooden rafters among old boxes, a steamer trunk and a worn rocking horse. A green banker's lamp throws a warm pool over a desk beneath a round gable window, where snow falls past the village rooftops, while a pendulum clock swings and ticks on the wall.
